settings.question: What's the difference between Essential and Premium?
settings.answer: Nothing in features — both are the complete OPENXMLJSON app with no file-size limit. Essential is free with monthly billing; Premium is a paid yearly license at $49.99.

settings.question: Who is the Premium edition for?
settings.answer: Anyone who prefers a yearly license over monthly billing. Premium is identical to Essential in features — the same complete app with no file-size limit.

settings.question: Who is the NARIKJSON (Enterprise) edition for?
settings.answer: Enterprise teams that need volume or site licensing, managed deployment and centralized updates. NARIKJSON is our top-tier edition, above Premium, for enterprise customers only — contact us for a tailored quote.

settings.question: Do you offer a free tier?
settings.answer: Yes — Essential (OPENXMLJSON) and NARIKJSON Free are both free with monthly billing, and include the full app with no file-size limit. The paid Premium and NARIKJSON editions are the same apps on a yearly license.

settings.question: How is a license delivered and what is a seat?
settings.answer: You receive a license key by email right after purchase. One seat activates OPENXMLJSON on up to two devices or operating systems for a single user.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Premium licenses are billed annually. If you cancel, your license stays valid until the next renewal date and you are not auto-charged for the following year.

settings.question: Do you offer volume licensing?
settings.answer: Yes — volume and site licensing are part of the NARIKJSON Edition. If you're buying for an organization, contact us for pricing off the standard rate.
